items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He'd start to change it around to Susan's house. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Some of them, yeah they play with the hand in the bell I'm sure they do some of them. Is that the way your father played it? I believe he used to play it. Sometime I've seen him with the hand in the bell.
He'd start to change it around to Susan's house.
